name: header-fields-benchmark
description: Benchmark that evaluates a model's ability to identify and extract header fields and their values from structured and unstructured text (e.g., document or metadata headers). It provides labeled examples mapping text spans to header field names/values for training and evaluation of extraction models. Useful for information-extraction and document-understanding tasks.
reputation: A small, specialized benchmark used by researchers working on document/header extraction with modest community adoption.
